M&T Bank is hiring a Software Engineer to develop and support in-house Financial Crimes applications. The role focuses on full-stack engineering, gathering and analyzing technical and business requirements, and contributing to secure, resilient software through the Software Development Lifecycle.
Banking
Consulting
Finance
Property & Casualty Insurance
Credit
Financial Services
Insurance
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Full stack development/engineering opportunity to enhance and provide ongoing support of critical, in-house, Financial Crimes applications
Work within the boundaries of the approved Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to solve business needs and minimize risks to the Bank through clean and resilient code with guidance as needed
Provide feedback in pull requests to other team members
Participate in code review by presenting and providing constructive feedback on code quality and improvements with team members
Write organized, clean, efficient, and secure source code at proficient level in minimum of one programming language to be verified by a senior team member
Utilize source control management tools to organize and maintain code with review from manager for structure and conflict resolution
Jointly analyze technical and business requirements for completeness, accuracy, and feasibility with senior team members to ensure accurate scoping of work
Collaborate, document, and communicate technical implementation details clearly and concisely within team on dependent requirements as needed
Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management
Promote an environment that supports a culture of belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand
Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable
Complete other related duties as assigned
Qualification
Java
Python
Spring Boot
Required
Associate's degree and a minimum of 3 years' systems analysis and/ or application development work experience OR Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 1 year systems analysis and/or application development work experience. In lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 5 years' education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 1 year of systems analysis and/or application development work experience
Professional proficiency with Java and Python
Experience with Spring Boot
Preferred
Basic analytical skills specific to application development
Experience working in a team environment
Ability to work autonomously
Ability to multitask on moderately complex projects
Strong organizational skills
Strong time management skills
Proficient verbal and written communication skills
